verdict.rationale: Bulk actions across many mail items, such as batch scan, forward or shred, are a fair question for a virtual mailbox service, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes per-item actions, like requesting that a single letter be scanned, forwarded or shredded. Nothing documents selecting and acting on many items at once, and the probes found no API (no OpenAPI spec, no llms.txt) through which bulk operations could be scripted.
